# The ball: a faceted sphere r 0.15 (exaggerated from 0.12), orange with a dark equator and a
# meridian seam band so its spin reads. Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Ball --base-color 0.9176 0.4667 0.1882 --no-slot
material new Seam --base-color 0.3176 0.2392 0.2392 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 0 18
apply --rotation
material assign Ball
active Ball
mode edit
select face where "(pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035) || (pos.x < 0.03 && pos.x > -0.03)"
material assign Seam
mode object
shade flat
export ball.glb
